theorem.statement: A polynomial-total sequence of one-variable witness-dominance contractions certified clause-by-clause by polynomial Resolution derivations composes to a polynomial Resolution refutation on UNSAT inputs. Exponential Resolution lower bounds for Tseitin contradictions therefore block this certificate system as a universal quotient currency.
theorem.source: Ben-Sasson and Wigderson, Short Proofs Are Narrow — Resolution Made Simple, JACM 48(2), 2001.

keymaster_barrier.scope: UNIVERSAL USE OF POLYNOMIAL-TOTAL CLAUSE-BY-CLAUSE RESOLUTION DOMINANCE CERTIFICATES. AUTARKY, ALGEBRAIC, GROUPED, OR REPRESENTATION-CHANGING WITNESS MAPS REMAIN OPEN.
